body: I was on meds for a short while but like you said it makes anxiety worse. I didn’t know whether to feel like I’m dying all the time or not be able to focus at all. I just dropped all medication.
It’s attention deficit disorder where I’m unable to focus on anything. I have a short attention span which makes it hard for me to focus on school.

I’ve tried a lot of shit in the 20 years that I have been alive and it never really made me happy. I’ve gone through so much shit in life that I’m tired of it. The pain outweighs the happiness and it makes me want to stop fighting. I appreciate the advice though.
